question: In which state is the five day religious festival of 'Shad Nongkrem' celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __Meghalaya__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Shad Nongkrem

 
 
• 
 
In the fall, Smit, the Khasi Hills' cultural hub, hosts the Nongkrem dance festival. Ka Pomblang Nongkrem Dance, also known as Nongkrem Dance, is a five-day Khasi religious celebration.

 
 
• 
 
The Nongkrem Dance Festival, like all other festivals in Meghalaya, is held in order to please the all-powerful Goddess Ka Blei Synshar in exchange for a bountiful harvest and the prosperity of the populace.
